text:
ryan: Heads-up: after the overnight canary we saw a brief WS reconnect wave in ap-northeast when the sticky-routing TTL was shortened. reconnects ~3x for ~7m. some customers reported duplicate session opens. anyone on call?
meera: saw it on the canary dashboard. resume acceptance rate dropped, lots of 'sticky-mismatch' errors in the gateway.
otavio: timeline looks like: canary flipped sticky-ttl 30s->5s, route-gen bumped, and then the session-affinity controller bounced pods. tight window.
ryan: sample logs:
```text
2026-08-14T03:01:12Z WARN resume reject token=rt:apn:7 cause=sticky_mismatch
2026-08-14T03:01:13Z INFO new session open sid=apn-0001 client=203.0.113.7 billing_tag=new_open
```
zach: immediate mitigation: re-increase sticky-ttl to 30s for ap-northeast and hold canary at 0%. also paused affinity-controller roll. low blast.
deploy-bot: config update applied: sticky-ttl ap-northeast -> 30s @ 2026-08-14T03:04:02Z
alerts-bot: reconnect-spike-ap-northeast auto-detected @ 2026-08-14T03:02:00Z (magnitude 3.1x).
meera: quick patch idea: allow resume tokens to be accepted for previous affinity-id for N seconds and emit metric stream.resume.affinity_grace_accept.
otavio: that reduces migration speed guarantees but prevents billing churn. we need clear signal in console if operator enables grace.
ryan: product/console ask: can we show a per-rollout 'affinity drift' risk score when changing sticky-ttl + affinity-controller version? PMs want a gate.
zach: also propose an automatic canary abort rule: if stream.resume.rejected_affinity_rate > 0.5% in first 5m, rollback canary. make it default for affinity-affecting rollouts. ticket SRE-7212.
meera: billing impact: several sessions billed as new opens; pinging billing-bot to create provisional credits. @billing-bot
billing-bot: BILL-662 created for provisional credit review, tagging support.
otavio: long-term: redesign resume token to separate 'affinity-hash' from resume-handle so token acceptance doesn't depend on short-lived affinity meta. also add preflight sim in rollout pipeline to combine sticky-ttl change + pod bounce + route-gen change.
ryan: instrumentation: emit stream.resume.affinity_accept_count, stream.resume.affinity_reject_count, and trace tag resume.affinity_grace=true when grace accepted. console can surface these in the canary timeline.
meera: UX ticket CON-1184 opened to add an "affinity risk" badge + modal. infra tickets INFRA-1190 (preflight sim) and SRE-7212 (auto-abort rule).
zach: mitigation complete and reconnects returned to baseline. i'll follow up with a short postmortem and timeline. paste facts here and i'll assemble. :memo:
